title: Adjuster Liaison Rule: Insurer Review Days in Rental Vehicle Coordination Network Courtesy
content:
**Rule.** In working out network courtesy days on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, the insurer review days are deducted from the lost calibration days. The insurer review days are the days the repair waited on the insurer for the latest supplement the insurer reviewed (the latest one routed to desk review, or when there is none the latest routed to field reinspection): where that supplement was submitted on or after the first failed in-house attempt and has been decided, they are the days from its submission to the insurer's decision on it; where no such reviewed supplement counts but a self-approved supplement was submitted on or after the first failed in-house attempt, they are 1 day; otherwise zero.

The first failed in-house attempt is the calibration order's first in-house attempt, where it failed, on the order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations opened for the insurance claim repair order the rental is for.

## Records read

The supplements of that repair order under Insurance Claim Repairs: each supplement's approval route (desk review, field reinspection or self-approved), its submission date and the date of the insurer's decision on it.

## Which supplement counts

| Supplements on the repair order | Reviewed supplement |
|---|---|
| At least one routed to desk review | The latest routed to desk review |
| None to desk review, at least one to field reinspection | The latest routed to field reinspection |
| Neither | None |

## Review days

| Situation | Insurer review days |
|---|---|
| The reviewed supplement was submitted on or after the first failed in-house attempt and has been decided | Days from its submission to the decision |
| Not that, but a self-approved supplement was submitted on or after the first failed in-house attempt | 1 |
| Any other case | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- First in-house attempt failed on the 4th; latest desk-review supplement submitted on the 5th and decided on the 8th: 3 insurer review days.
- The same supplement submitted on the 3rd, before the failed attempt; a self-approved supplement submitted on the 6th: 1 day.
- A desk-review supplement submitted on the 5th and not yet decided, and no self-approved supplement on or after the 4th: 0.
